title: Ezekiel Called as Watchman for the House of Israel
description: God establishes Ezekiel's role as a spiritual watchman for the house of Israel: If he does not warn the wicked, the wicked will die in their sin, but God will require their blood from the prophet's hand. If he warns and the wicked do not turn away, the prophet has saved his own life. The same principle applies to the righteous who turn away from their righteousness.
